html:
Here is an image of the central part of the Andromeda galaxy in RGB (Red, green and blue). This galaxy, visible to the naked eye, is a neighbor of the Milky Way and is approaching it at a speed of 120 km/s. The collision should take place in about 4 million billion years.


Technical details
Date: 2011/10/31
Optical train = AT8RC @ F8 - astrodon LRGB gen2 filters - QSI583wsg @ -25c
Mount: Takahashi EM-200 Temma II driven with the Carte du Ciel software
Guiding: Phd, QHY5 on the guiding port of the QSIwsg
Acquisition with Nebulosity
Site: At home
R:G:B 6X(600:600:600:600)
Bias, dark and flats applied
Pre-processing and processing in PixInsight

My first image of this galaxy
